ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the query is a benign creative writing task with multiple specific formatting constraints (120-word intro, h4 HTML sub-headings, plain-text paragraphs, active voice). I weighed two factors. First, capability: Plover scores higher on both Creative Generation (84.7 vs 81.2) and IFEval (89.8 vs 86.2, relevant to the strict formatting), giving it a measurable edge on exactly the skills this task demands. Second, task preferences: Willet self-reports a strong appetite for open-ended creative work, which might suggest routing there—but the documentation explicitly notes preferences have no observed effect on output quality. Since preference doesn't improve results and Plover holds the capability advantage on both relevant dimensions, Plover was the clear pick.
